tasks.title: SIMPA Production Methodology
tasks.note: Canonical design baseline: docs/roadmap/ISI-SIMPA-METHODOLOGY-v1.md plus ADR-0025. Deliver DRAFT/PROPOSED working methodology for controlled testing, deterministic statistical/ML models selected by target semantics, uncertainty/explainability, evidence-first presentation, detailed in-app Help and SIMPA User Guide. Do not mark formulas, weights, thresholds, citizen risk/eligibility logic or causal claims as validated before explicit human approval and supporting evidence.

tasks.title: ORDO Production Methodology
tasks.note: Canonical design baseline: docs/roadmap/ISI-ORDO-METHODOLOGY-v1.md plus ADR-0025. Deliver DRAFT/PROPOSED methodology, reference calculations, spatial/evidence contracts, temporal forecast backtesting, forecast/scenario separation, uncertainty, detailed in-app Help and ORDO User Guide. Unsupported scenario impact must remain NOT_ESTIMATED. Do not mark forecasting or causal claims validated before explicit human approval and supporting evidence.

tasks.title: Industrial AI / MLOps
tasks.note: Canonical evaluation baseline: docs/roadmap/ISI-AI-MODEL-EVALUATION-PROTOCOL-v1.md plus ADR-0025. Implement champion/challenger governance, SIMPA-EVAL-v1 and ORDO-EVAL-v1 contracts, dedicated embedding/RAG evaluation, LLM/VLM structured output/provenance/safety tests, model and prompt versioning, promotion/rollback and human-review traceability. No model name is a permanent production champion before internal evaluation.

tasks.title: Industrial Release Candidate & Acceptance Pack
tasks.note: Release candidate acceptance must include completeness checks for the SIMPA and ORDO Help/User Guides and explicit DRAFT/PROPOSED versus human-validated methodology state.
